finding: The proposed committed fact/receipt path for NOT_ATTEMPTED plus complete ABSENT is not closed by any listed public commit entry.

minimal_static_state.evidence_assumption: Assume C has complete independent actual ABSENT evidence and a verified full event prefix proving NOT_ATTEMPTED; this is a design premise, not a performed read or recovery result.

frozen_rules.rule: progress is a projection of committed facts; NOT_APPLIED/UNKNOWN interrupts the old plan; NOT_ATTEMPTED ABSENT may have a fact with null intent/obligation.
complete receipt requires sufficient results/facts for every action; tail must not be invented or dispatched; recovery facts use commit_reconciliation.
commit_action_result requires current original committed_intent, original ACTIVE owner and RUNNING cursor, and rejects INTERRUPTED/restarted intents.
commit_reconciliation verifies original obligation/committed intent and may create RECOVERY fact bound to exact resolution_ref.
NOT_ATTEMPTED fact has null intent/obligation; RECOVERY requires exact committed resolution_ref.
the supplied positive design fact has origin_phase EXECUTION, resolution_ref null, intent_ref null and obligation_id null.

mismatch: a ReconciliationResult for C would require fabricating the mandatory intent/obligation

consequence: D04 permits an immutable committed C fact and full receipt, but the frozen public API does not assign a valid producer/transaction/event/authority path for it after B interrupts the plan. Implementation must guess a new path or remain progress-only despite complete ABSENT evidence.
required_design_resolution: Specify an explicit public unattempted-fact commit entry or a precisely bounded nullable branch of an existing entry, including event type, plan-state/owner/generation rules, full NOT_ATTEMPTED prefix evidence, fresh independent ABSENT validation, uniqueness/CAS, allowed fact origin, and receipt aggregation. Do not fabricate intent/obligation/resolution or resume the old tail.
